title: Quenched Wholesome Dutch Sweet Potatoes Casserole
description: A moist and flavorful Dutch sweet potatoes casserole featuring dulce de leche and rendered fat, suitable for Jain-friendly meals.

ingredients.name: 2 large sweet potatoes
ingredients.notes: choose sweet potatoes that are high in moisture

ingredients.name: 1 cup vegan cream
ingredients.notes: unsweetened almond milk or soy milk also work

instructions: Scrub the sweet potatoes clean and poke some holes in them with a fork.
Bake the sweet potatoes in the oven for about 45 minutes, or until they are tender when pierced with a fork.
Let the sweet potatoes cool slightly, then peel and dice them into 1-inch pieces.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked sweet potatoes, onion-garlic mixture, dulce de leche, and vegan cream.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 20-25 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
